title: Toofaan
desc: An orphan surviving on the streets of Mumbai grows into a feared thug, but his path shifts when he meets Ananya, who inspires him to rise above his past and discover his true calling in boxing.

title: Teri Meherbaniyan
desc: After Ram, a kind-hearted government officer, is murdered for defending a village from oppression, his loyal dog Moti becomes the unlikely avenger. Witnessing the crime, Moti sets out to punish the killers and bring justice to his master's memory.

title: Main Khiladi Tu Anari
desc: Inspector Karan seeks justice for his brother Arjun's murder. But Deepak, an actor, complicates things by shadowing him to add realism to his role.

title: English Vinglish
desc: Shashi, a housewife and caterer, is mocked for not knowing English. Her journey to learn the language helps her rediscover herself and prove her worth as a mother and wife.

title: Biwi No. 1
desc: Pooja, a loving wife, is devastated when her husband Prem falls for model Rupali. With support from friends, she confidently takes charge, making Prem realize her true worth.

title: Cirkus
desc: Chaos erupts when two pairs of twins, separated at birth, unknowingly arrive in the same city. Their identical faces spark nonstop confusion, misunderstandings, and hilarious mayhem.

title: Uri - The Surgical Strike
desc: After a deadly terrorist attack in Uri, Major Vihaan Singh Shergill leads a covert operation to eliminate the terrorists responsible, executing a high-risk mission deep across the border.

title: Sajan Chale Sasural
desc: After Shyamsunder assumes his wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he discovers Pooja is alive, he scrambles to hide both marriages while juggling between them.

title: Turtle
desc: Ramkaran struggles to extract water in a drought-hit village. As thirst grows, villagers search for desperate solutions, revealing the harsh realities of survival and hope.

title: Don (1978)
desc: Don, a gangster, dies during a police chase. Vijay, Don's lookalike, infiltrates his gang on DSP D'Silva's orders to gather information but a change of events lands him in trouble.

title: Pardes
desc: Kishorilal chooses Ganga for his NRI son. But Ganga shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son, leading to a conflict between duty and love.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: Kumki 2
desc: Bhoomi saves and raises a baby elephant, forming a deep bond before it vanishes. Years later, he ventures into the forest, hoping to reunite with his lost companion.

title: Dunki
desc: A group of friends risk everything to reach the UK through a dangerous route called 'donkey flight', facing life-threatening challenges and the harsh reality of illegal immigration.

title: Baaghi 4
desc: After a failed suicide attempt, a man struggles with reality as hidden truths and obsession blur his world, leaving his family in turmoil and his path tangled in love and mystery.

title: Socha Na Tha
desc: Viren cant imagine having an arranged marriage. His parents want him to meet Aditi. They refuse to get married but stay friends. Will Cupid strike and change their minds?
